ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a PNP transistor circuit. The emitter is connected to +10 V through a 1 kΩ resistor; the base is connected to ground through a 270 kΩ resistor; the collector is connected to ground through a 1 kΩ resistor. The problem gives the common-emitter forward current gain beta_F = 100. Reasoning: First assume the forward active region. When the PNP transistor is in forward active operation, the emitter junction is forward biased, so one can write V_E = V_B + 0.7 V. The base current flows through 270 kΩ to ground, therefore I_B = V_B / 270 kΩ. The emitter current I_E = (beta_F + 1) I_B = 101 I_B, and at the same time the emitter resistor current is I_E = (10 - V_E) / 1 kΩ. Substituting V_E = V_B + 0.7 gives: 101(V_B/270 kΩ) = (10 - V_B - 0.7)/1 kΩ = (9.3 - V_B)/1 kΩ. Solving gives V_B ≈ 6.77 V, V_E ≈ 7.47 V. Thus I_C = beta_F I_B ≈ 100(6.77/270 kΩ) ≈ 2.5 mA, and the collector voltage V_C ≈ I_C(1 kΩ) ≈ 2.5 V. Therefore V_E > V_B > V_C, the emitter-base junction is forward biased, the collector-base junction is reverse biased, and the assumption is consistent, so the transistor operates in the forward active region.

推理：按正向有源区先假设。PNP 管正向有源时发射结正偏，可写 V_E = V_B + 0.7 V。基极电流通过 270 kΩ 到地，因此 I_B = V_B / 270 kΩ。发射极电流 I_E = (beta_F + 1) I_B = 101 I_B，同时发射极电阻电流为 I_E = (10 - V_E) / 1 kΩ。代入 V_E = V_B + 0.7 得：101(V_B/270 kΩ) = (10 - V_B - 0.7)/1 kΩ = (9.3 - V_B)/1 kΩ。解得 V_B ≈ 6.77 V，V_E ≈ 7.47 V。于是 I_C = beta_F I_B ≈ 100(6.77/270 kΩ) ≈ 2.5 mA，集电极电压 V_C ≈ I_C(1 kΩ) ≈ 2.5 V。因此 V_E > V_B > V_C，发射-基极结正向偏置，集电极-基极结反向偏置，假设一致，所以晶体管工作在正向有源区。
